summary.text: MODULVEGGER TRONDHEIM AS is a private limited company registered in Trondheim, founded 2000-01-03. MODULVEGGER TRONDHEIM AS er registrert for kjøp og salg av varer og tjenester og alt som står i forbindelse med dette, samt deltakelse som aksjonær eller på annen måte i andre foretagender. It was previously named MODULVEGGER INNEX AS until 2009-08-04. Its main industry code is 43.320: joinery installation. The register shows 41 employees and 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 84 188 738 NOK and the annual result was 1 516 005 NOK; operating income was up from 64 347 693 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from -2 662 780 NOK in 2024 to 1 516 005 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from -161 946 NOK in 2024 to 475 100 NOK in 2025. The registered employee count went from 33 on 2025-12-13 to 41 on 2026-09-15. The register's most recent update was on 2026-09-15 (antallAnsatte, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
